arxiv-2005-03636.title: A Gas Monitoring Chamber for High Pressure Applications
arxiv-2005-03636.creator: Nick Thamm
arxiv-2005-03636.description: Abstract Time Projection Chambers (TPCs) operated at high pressure have become a topic of interest for future long baseline neutrino experiments. Pressurized gas retains the low momentum threshold for particle detection of atmospheric TPCs, but offers a larger target mass for neutrino interactions at the same volume.

arxiv-2111-14960.title: Validating CircaCP: a Generic Sleep-Wake Cycle Detection Algorithm
arxiv-2111-14960.creator: Shanshan Chen ∗, Xinxin Sun Department of Biostatistics, School of Medicine, Virginia Commonwealth University shanshan.chen@vcuhealth.org
arxiv-2111-14960.description: Abstract Sleep-wake cycle detection is a key step when extrapolating sleep patterns from actigraphy data. Numerous supervised detection algorithms have been developed with parameters estimated from and optimized for a particular dataset, yet their generalizability from sensor to sensor or study to study is unknown.

arxiv-2208-05538.title: Preservation of complete Baireness
arxiv-2208-05538.creator: Sergey Medvedev
arxiv-2208-05538.description: Abstract . The main result is the following. Let f : X → Y f\colon X\rightarrow Y be a continuous mapping of a completely Baire space X X onto a hereditary weakly Preiss-Simon regular space Y Y such that the image of every open subset of X X is a resolvable set in Y Y .

arxiv-2303-09381.title: Multi-modal Differentiable Unsupervised Feature Selection
arxiv-2303-09381.creator: Junchen Yang, Ofir Lindenbaum, Yuval Kluger, Ariel Jaffe
arxiv-2303-09381.description: Abstract Multi-modal high throughput biological data presents a great scientific opportunity and a significant computational challenge. In multi-modal measurements, every sample is observed simultaneously by two or more sets of sensors. In such settings, many observed variables in both modalities are often nuisance and do not carry information about the phenomenon of interest.

arxiv-2307-13823.description: Abstract . We consider the problem of classifying Kolmogorov automorphisms (or K K -automorphisms for brevity) up to isomorphism. Within the collection of measure-preserving transformations, Bernoulli shifts have the ultimate mixing property, and K K -automorphisms have the next-strongest mixing properties of any widely considered family of transformations. arxiv-2504-13527.title: Designing a Reliable Lateral Movement Detector Using a Graph Foundation Model
arxiv-2504-13527.creator: Corentin Larroche
arxiv-2504-13527.description: Abstract Foundation models have recently emerged as a new paradigm in machine learning (ML). These models are pre-trained on large and diverse datasets and can subsequently be applied to various downstream tasks with little or no retraining. This allows people without advanced ML expertise to build ML applications, accelerating innovation across many fields.

arxiv-2512-01503.title: Bayesian inferences on covariant density functionals from multimessenger astrophysical data: The influences of parametrizations of density dependent couplings
arxiv-2512-01503.creator: Guo-Jun Wei, Jia-Jie Li, Armen Sedrakian, Yong-Jia Wang, Qing-Feng Li, Fu-Hu Liu
arxiv-2512-01503.description: Abstract Covariant density functionals have been successfully applied to the description of finite nuclei and dense nuclear matter. These functionals are often constructed by introducing density dependence into the nucleon–meson couplings, typically through functions that depend only on the vector, i.e., proper baryon density.

pmc-10765265.title: A Rare Case of Chronic Invasive Pulmonary Aspergillosis
pmc-10765265.creator: Vikram B Vikhe, Devansh Khandol, Aniket A Garud
pmc-10765265.description: Invasive pulmonary aspergillosis (IPA) and invasive aspergillosis (IA) are two examples of the broad clinical spectrum of Aspergillus infection. It mainly affects severely immunocompromised hosts, while immunocompetent people can sometimes be affected, especially those receiving treatment in the intensive care unit (ICU) for emergency cases with few instances of chronic cases.

pmc-11389271.title: Mental disorders in adults from Ribeirão Preto, Brazil: a cross-sectional analysis of two birth cohorts
pmc-11389271.creator: Luis Felipe Scarabelot, Jesem Douglas Yamall Orellana, Viviane Cunha Cardoso, Marco Antonio Barbieri, Ricardo Carvalho Cavalli, Heloisa Bettiol, Bernardo Lessa Horta, Cristina Marta Del-Ben
pmc-11389271.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundIn Brazil, the prevalence of mental disorders is heterogeneous, with most studies conducted in large cities with high population density. This study aimed to assess the prevalence of mental disorders and psychiatric comorbidities among young adults (22–23 years old) and adults (37–38 years old) from Ribeirão Preto, a city located in the Northeast of the São Paulo state, with approximately 700,000 inhabitants, and to explore associations with sociodemographic variables, suicide risk, and health service usage.

pmc-13145172.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A2424 EPIDEMIOLOGICAL PROFILE AND CLINICAL OUTCOMES FROM PATIENTS WHO UNDERWENT DESCOMPRESSIVE CRANIECTOMY FOR MALIGNANT MIDDLE CEREBRAL ARTERY STROKE IN A BRAZILIAN HOSPITAL
pmc-13145172.creator: Alexia Carneiro D E Almeida, Joao Andrade, Maramelia Miranda Alves, Fabiano Moulin de Moraes, Eva Carolina Andrade Rocha, Feres Chaddad, Raul Valiente, Ingrid Demosthenes Wanzileu, Luisa Avezum, Gisele Sampaio Silva
pmc-13145172.description: Background and aimsIschemic stroke remains a leading cause of mortality worldwide. Malignant Middle Cerebral Artery Infarction (MMCAI) is associated with high mortality rates under conservative medical management alone. In this context, decompressive craniectomy (DC) emerges as a life-saving intervention, despite the substantial morbidity observed among survivors.

pmc-13215600.title: An intronic variant in Ferredoxin Reductase (FDXR) creates a cryptic exon in Quarter Horses with Equine Juvenile Spinocerebellar Ataxia
pmc-13215600.creator: Briana N. Brown, Anna R. Dahlgren, Sharmila Ghosh, Blythe Durbin-Johnson, Andrew Willis, Cassandra Olivas, Daniel York, Robert Grahn, Rebecca R. Bellone, Gino A. Cortopassi, Andrew D. Miller, C. Titus Brown, Kevin Woolard, Carrie J. Finno
pmc-13215600.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Equine Juvenile Spinocerebellar Ataxia (EJSCA) is a novel autosomal recessive neurologic disease in Quarter Horses. Affected foals display a progressive proprioceptive ataxia by 1–5 weeks of age, leading to recumbency and necessitating euthanasia. Whole genome sequencing was performed on 7 EJSCA cases and unaffected horses that included 4 obligate carriers, 4 unaffected half or full-siblings, and 28 unrelated, unaffected control Quarter Horses.

pmc-13243614.title: Image type reveals evolutionarily shaped perceptual and conceptual mechanisms of pareidolia
pmc-13243614.creator: N Göbel, M Camenzind, T Nef, U P Mosimann, R M Müri, A K Eberhard-Moscicka
pmc-13243614.description: Pareidolia—the perception of illusory patterns such as faces or objects in ambiguous stimuli—has been extensively studied, but less is known about how different visual environments shape this phenomenon. This study investigated pareidolia experienced in unmodified natural images (NI) and white noise (WN) images in 81 healthy participants under open-ended instructions.

pmc-13323970.title: Comparison of biochemical oxidative stress markers of glucose tolerance tests performed for
pmc-13323970.creator: Bora Coşkun, Buğra Coşkun, Burcu Timur, Tolga Ecemiş, Merve Ayas Özkan, Begüm Köse Kinci, Coşkun Şimşir, Ramazan Erda Pay, Burak Gültekin
pmc-13323970.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study aimed to investigated whether any differences in the oxidative stress (OS) occurred between the two different methods used in gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) screening. In this cross-sectional case-control study, 41 women and 47 women in the 24th-28th weeks of pregnancy underwent a 50-g glucose challenge test (GCT) (Group 1) and 75-g oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) (Group 2), respectively.

pmc-13378215.title: Steric Coordination Modulated Iodine Chemistry With Four‐Electron Conversion for Zinc‐Iodine Batteries
pmc-13378215.creator: Shuai Wang, Haoran Wang, Yujue Yang, Yuanyuan Gao, Yaopeng Wu, Junze Zhang, Jingxin Zhao, Yuejiao Chen, Bingang Xu
pmc-13378215.description: The advancement of high‐voltage aqueous zinc‐iodine batteries is impeded by the instability of I+ intermediates during the conversion process, which suffers from hydrolysis and poor reversibility in conventional electrolytes. To overcome these challenges, we propose a steric coordination strategy employing Cl− and sulfonate‐rich TES− ions to modulate the coordination environment of I+ ions.

pmc-13594523.title: Cxcl9 as a Marker of Adipose Tissue Changes Caused by Bariatric Surgery and Psoriasis
pmc-13594523.creator: Zheng Zhou, Ling Kuang
pmc-13594523.description: BackgroundBariatric surgery has been shown to improve psoriasis, but the underlying molecular mechanisms remain unclear. This study aimed to investigate shared molecular mechanisms between bariatric surgery-induced adipose changes and psoriasis using bioinformatics approaches.MethodsTranscriptomic data from adipose tissue before and after bariatric surgery and from psoriatic lesions were obtained from the GEO database.
